card.name: Words just before 'warm' in climate text
card.fires_on: Small words (themselves, and, of, is, the) in nature or climate passages where the next word is likely 'warm' or 'warmer'. Typical settings are temperature, seasons, sun and heat.

modes.label: Staying warm
modes.description: Word right before 'warm' in talk of keeping or getting warm.
modes.example: They do not have furry coats to keep<< themselves>> warm like bumblebees do.

modes.label: Climate and seasons
modes.description: Linking word in climate descriptions that contrast cold and warm seasons.
modes.example: Hungary has a continental climate, with cold winters<< and>> warm to hot summers.

modes.label: Water temperature
modes.description: Word before a temperature term in instructions about heated water.
modes.example: Be sure that the heel area is completely immersed and that the water<< is>> not hot enough to burn.

card.writes: It pushes the model to write 'warm' and 'warmth' (also in Chinese) and to avoid 'cold', 'hard' and 'harsh'.
